$why: Moved out of spec-mode-runner.js reviewRoster on 2026-08-15 (3 of 20).
The roster reviewer is the only adversary the roster has: it is what stops a defective
brief reaching an implementer. Extracted verbatim into a builder first, then pinned byte
for byte on BOTH branches — the documentation section is entirely different prose when
nothing was fetched, and pinning only the populated case would let that branch rot.
The documentation section is one value, assembled by the caller. A template that branches
is a program, and a program cannot be reviewed as prose.
2026-08-17: THIS REVIEWER COULD NOT SEE AN ABSENCE.
It opened 'review every brief below' and received only briefs, so a roster of two investigators
and no implementer was returned 'sound - 0 finding(s), 0 blocking' and the run died several
steps later at assignment. Every agent present was well-formed; the defect was who was missing,
and a member-by-member review cannot see that.
A gate was written downstream to catch it. That gate then failed a HEALTHY run on a false
positive and was removed. The reviewer is the right place: it is handed what the registry
already declares - the artefacts this run requires, the seam that produces each, and which
roster member resolves to which seam - and asked whether the team covers them. No role or kind
is named in this prompt; the coverage block is derived.
body:
__PERSONA__

THE ROSTER JUST MINTED FOR THIS PROJECT — review it, both as individual briefs and AS A TEAM.

WHAT THIS RUN NEEDS THE TEAM TO PRODUCE, and who in this roster can produce it:
__COVERAGE_BLOCK__

A roster can be made entirely of well-formed agents and still be unable to do the work. Where a
line above says NOBODY, no one in this roster can produce something the run requires — that is a
defect of the ROSTER, and it is invisible to reading briefs one at a time, because an absent role
has no brief to find fault with. Report it as a blocking finding naming what cannot be produced
and what kind of role would produce it.

Now review every brief below:

__BRIEF_BLOCK__

THE CODELINES THESE BRIEFS DESCRIBE, and what each one declares:
__CODELINE_BLOCK__

THE WORK THE PROJECT WAS ASKED TO DO:
__TICKET_BLOCK__

__DOC_SECTION__

__TOOL_LINE__

Return every defect you can evidence, and nothing you cannot.

Where a finding turns on whether a named dependency or path is present in a codeline, fill in
the verification field as well as writing the prose. The pipeline re-runs that exact check
against the repository and DISCARDS any finding the check refutes — so a careless reading
costs nothing, and a correct one is confirmed independently of how convincingly you argued it.
description: Review every brief in a freshly minted roster and report evidenced defects.
